card.name: First digit of a multi-digit dose number
card.fires_on: A single digit that begins or sits inside a multi-digit number, most often a dose or concentration in mg, mcg or mL. The number continues in the next token, usually after other doses in a titration list.

modes.label: Leading digit of a dose
modes.description: The first digit of a dose figure that continues in the following token, often one step in an escalating dose series.

modes.label: Digit inside a number table
modes.description: A digit within a long number in a table of values or a list of strengths.

card.plain: It marks the start of a dose number that is still being written out, such as the 5 in 570 mg.
